dashboard.subtitle: Track bookings, payments, and prescriptions — all in one place.
dashboard.verifyEmailBody: We sent a link to {email}. Click it to confirm — or resend from Security.
dashboard.noBookingsBody: Book your first consultation to see it here.
dashboard.quickActionsBody: Jump to the most-used parts of your account.

bookings.title: My bookings
bookings.subtitle: Your consultation request history and status updates.
bookings.unavailable: Booking history is temporarily unavailable. Please try again soon.
bookings.noBookingsBody: You have not made any booking requests. Start by booking your first consultation.

orders.title: My orders
orders.subtitle: Health tests + online prescriptions you've ordered. Consultation bookings live under 'My bookings'.

prescriptions.title: Prescriptions
prescriptions.subtitle: Clinical scripts your doctor has issued, plus any online prescription products you've ordered.
prescriptions.issuedByDoctorHint: Scripts written during a signed consultation. Read-only history.
prescriptions.noPrescriptions: No prescriptions issued yet. After a consultation, scripts your doctor writes will appear here.
prescriptions.onlineOrdersHint: Online prescription products you've ordered — like health tests, but for medication.

medicalFiles.title: Medical files
medicalFiles.subtitle: Your uploaded reports and documents from doctors.

payments.title: Payments
payments.subtitle: Receipts for consultations you've booked. Stripe sends an email receipt the moment a charge clears — this page is the running log.
payments.noPaymentsBody: Once you complete a paid booking the receipt lands here. Free consultations don't appear in this list.

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Your contact details for bookings and confirmations.
profile.emailNote: Email can't be changed yet. Contact support if you need to switch.
profile.phoneNote: Used so the clinic can reach you about your booking. Leave blank if you prefer email only.
profile.dobNote: We use this on every booking so you don't have to retype it. Leave blank to keep it off your account.
profile.medicalSubtitle: Optional. Helps us print prescriptions and ship medication. Doctors see this on your chart.
profile.preferredPharmacyHint: Used on prescriptions if your doctor doesn't pick another.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Manage your password and email verification status.
security.unverifiedBody: Your email address ({email}) hasn't been verified yet. Verifying confirms you can receive booking + password-reset emails.
security.verificationSent: Verification email sent. Check your inbox — link expires in 24 hours.
security.gdprBody: Under GDPR you can download everything we hold about you, or delete your account.
security.changePasswordBody: You'll need your current password to confirm the change.
security.passwordNoMatch: New password and confirmation do not match.
security.passwordTooShort: New password must be at least 8 characters.
security.passwordUpdated: Password updated. Use the new one next time you sign in.
security.deleteWarning: This schedules your account for deletion in 30 days. You can keep using your account and cancel the request anytime before then from this page.
security.deletionScheduledBanner: Your account is scheduled for deletion on {date}.
security.signOutAllDevicesBody: This ends every signed-in session, including this one — you'll need to log in again.

family.title: Family members
family.subtitle: Add the people you book consultations for. Approve who may use your plan credits and discounts.
family.empty: You have not added any family members yet.
family.canUseCreditsHelp: Can use plan credits & discounts for their consultations.
family.tierBanner: Family booking with plan credits is available on the Premium plan.

corporate.title: Corporate benefits
corporate.noMembershipBody: If your employer offers a corporate health plan, ask your company admin for an invitation.
corporate.welcome: Welcome! Your corporate membership with {company} is set up
corporate.welcomeFinish: — finish the steps below to activate your benefits.
corporate.inactiveNotice: Your company's plan is currently inactive — corporate benefits are paused until it is reactivated.
corporate.checklistDesc: Complete these steps to unlock your corporate discount and benefit card.
corporate.stepProfile: Profile complete (date of birth, address, phone)
corporate.cardDesc: Show this card (or its number) when asked to verify your corporate membership.
corporate.cardPending: Your benefit card is issued automatically once your membership is active.
corporate.cardInactive: This card is currently inactive — corporate benefits are not available. Contact your company admin.
corporate.requestsDesc: Requests from your company that need you to book.
corporate.beneficiariesUsage: Family members covered by your plan — {used} of {max} used.
corporate.maxReached: You've used all {max} beneficiary places. Remove one to add another.
corporate.privacyNote: Your employer sees onboarding status and counts only — never your consultations, medical records, or your beneficiaries' personal details.
